Description.ShowAttackRange: Draw the local hero's basic attack range.
Description.ShowMonsterThreatRanges: Draw predicted monster attack and skill zones.
Description.ShowProjectileThreatRanges: Draw active enemy projectile paths as rectangular threat zones whose color updates by distance from the hero or time to impact.
Description.EnableAutoDodge: While the auto dodge key is held, dodge monster attacks, skill zones, and projectiles.
Description.AutoDodgeUseMovementSkill: Use the movement skill first when it is ready and can reach a safe point.
Description.AutoDodgeLevel: Green dodges every threat level, including unreleased previews. Yellow dodges active threats within 1.8 units or 1.8 seconds. Red dodges active threats within 0.8 units or 0.8 seconds.
Description.AutoDodgeCommandInterval: Minimum seconds between auto dodge commands. Lower values react faster but issue more movement commands.
Description.AutoDodgeKey: Hold this key to enable auto dodge.
